# Let'sShare
> Let'sShare is a realtime code sharing platform for developers: create shareable snippet links, collaborate in a live editor, and run code side by side.

Let'sShare helps individuals and teams share code instantly without setup friction. Core capabilities include share links, realtime collaborative editing, an in-browser editor, explore and discovery of public snippets, and account features for managing shares.

## Product
- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point
- [Share](/share): Create a new shareable code snippet
- [Explore](/explore): Browse public snippets
- [Editor](/editor): Realtime collaborative code editor
- [Login](/login): Sign in to manage your shares
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a Let'sShare account

- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy
